title: Cherie M NDE 3931
content: In 2000 I was shot in the right temple point blank with a twenty-two caliber handgun. At first, I could hear everything but I was paralyzed and blind. I was speaking, but not sure if I could be heard. It was as if I were in another dimension. I kept saying I'm not dead yet and I heard him go outside and then reenter. Then I heard him make the 911 call. All of the sudden there was a dark tunnel. I was being sucked through towards the light. When I got to the light, there was Jesus. It wasn't visual but there was no disputing who it was. He took me by the hand. The profoundly incredible peace was beyond conception. We walked hand and hand for some time. It was hard to tell because it was like there was no sense of time. I remember feeling the presence of my deceased father in the distance. I also remember not wanting to come back. It was bliss. Jesus told me only he has to choose and it wasn't time for me. That's all I can recall before I came back into excruciating pain, still on my couch with horrible nausea, screaming to push me forward or roll me over, I was choking on my own blood and getting cold again. The last thing I heard was the paramedic saying, 'No you're not, calm down,' and the lights went out. I was told that when wheeled into Charity Hospital I was spitting in the surgeons' faces that I simply refused to die. They noted they had never seen that kind of will power to live in all their careers. They did two craniotomies removing seven ounces of my brain along with a bone in my skull and then replacing it but still leaving bullet fragments and metal plates. I was out of the hospital and walking within thirty days. I have had spiritual enlightenments and visions since. I never had them before, and a lot of déjà vu.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus was identified as present at the light; "It wasn't visual but there was no disputing who it was." He "took me by the hand."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Shot point blank in the right temple with a .22 caliber handgun.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard events around her (e.g., perpetrator leaving/reentering; 911 call) while paralyzed and blind; then later heard paramedic statement before "the lights went out."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Auditory awareness while paralyzed/blind preceded the tunnel; then tunnel to light/Jesus; then told it wasn't time and returned to body with pain.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Jesus was identified clearly despite being "not visual." The experiencer reported hearing real-world events while paralyzed and blind, describing it as "another dimension."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "All of the sudden there was a dark tunnel. I was being sucked through towards the light."; "The profoundly incredible peace was beyond conception."; "It was like there was no sense of time."; "Jesus told me only he has to choose and it wasn't time for me."; "I remember not wanting to come back."
